reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Set Kubernetes 1.32 as min supported version by @stefanprodan in https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/pull/5533", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: upgrade-blocked

consequence.statement: Upgrading to Flux 2.7.0 on Kubernetes versions below 1.32 will fail due to the minimum version requirement not being met.

proposed.statement: Flux 2.7.0 sets Kubernetes 1.32 as the minimum supported version.
